referees.quote: However, the current paper, particularly the QSH claim, requires additional analysis, control experiments, and more internally consistent evidence.
In its present form, I cannot recommend publication. However, after satisfactory revision this manuscript might be suitable for publication in Nature Communications.
Several conceptual and methodological assumptions require stronger justification. The manuscript, in its present form, remains inconclusive regarding the topological nature of the grown samples.

note: Only Version 0 (first round) was used. The file shows no sign of a transfer from another journal. No referee co-signed another's report. None of the three used an explicit recommendation term, so each level is inferred. R2 is the closest call. It is called major because the referee says it cannot be published in its present form and asks for a new dI/dV map, although its other requests are mostly discussion changes. R3 was rated major rather than reject because the report asks for stronger justification and extra checks (Wannier convergence, wavefunction plots, GW, ARPES, stability) rather than declaring the paper unsuitable.
